name: Look up a member record and balances
description: Retrieve a member's contact details and the full share grid -- id, type, balance and status for every share. The row count varies per member, so the shares come back as typed rows rather than a fixed set of fields.
goal: Sign on, search for member number {member_id}, select that member, and read their record and share balances.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with (e.g. teller1, super1).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Operator password. Supplied at invocation and never persisted.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch code to sign on against.

outputs.name: shares
outputs.description: Every share on the member, with balance and status.
